notes: Customer profile: mid-to-large national law firm with heavy regulatory discovery work for financial services and healthcare clients.
Primary problem: current keyword search misses semantic matches across redacted/boilerplate docs; sifting through 10-100k docs per matter is manual and expensive.
Data shape: ~120M documents total (archival custodies), average uncompressed doc ~1.8KB, many extracted OCR PDFs with noise. Expect cold+hot tiers (recent matters high QPS).

Technical ask: embeddings + approximate nearest neighbor retrieval for candidate generation, then a small cross-encoder reranker for precision on top-20 candidates. Must support incremental indexing and near-real-time updates when new filings are added.

Performance targets: end-to-end p95 latency for search (retrieve+rerank) <= 350ms for small matters (<10k docs), p95 <= 700ms for large matters; throughput baseline 150 QPS during peak ingestion/querying windows. Cost target: <$0.02 per query (avg) - want options to trade cost/latency via batching/quantization.
Indexing scale: expect ~120M docs initially, growth ~20%/yr; vector index estimate ~300GB after quantization; will need capacity planning for shard count and snapshot retention.

Security/compliance: must deploy in customer VPC or on-prem air-gapped option for high-sensitivity matters. Audit logging required for all query and admin actions; retention window 7+ years for case history. KMS integration mandatory; HSM optional.
Reranking model constraints: legal-domain fine-tuned reranker preferred; customer will bring own models for competitive matters but wants Redwood to support custom model variants and canary rollouts.
Non-functional: immutable audit trail for query history, user attribution (SSO identity), redact logs for PII, configurable retention and legal hold flags per matter.
Quote from Head of eDiscovery: "We need answers we can defend in court — reproducible ranking and an audit trail are non-negotiable."

Customer is sensitive to cold-start cost; wants a POC that demonstrates cost per query reduction via Redwood Optimize (batching + prefix caching) and a plan for model quantization without quality regression.
PV: interested in private deployment; immediate pilot on Dedicated for 3 months to validate latency/throughput before full Private/VPC rollout.
